scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @bojro/frontend dev" "uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend ruff check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter @bojro/frontend format:check && uv run --project backend ruff format --check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend
scripts.typecheck:backend: uv run --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/app backend/tests
scripts.test:backend: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
